pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Scrub & Wag is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A happy, freshly-bathed dog with a big grin

children: We started Scrub & Wag because grooming shouldn’t be a scary day. Too many places pack dogs into crates, rush them through, and hand back a stressed pup. We wanted the opposite.
So we keep it small, gentle and unhurried — fear-free handling, cage-free drying, and one dog at a time per groomer. Just clean, happy dogs and owners who trust us with them.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Treats, patience and breaks when your dog needs them. We go at your dog’s pace, not a timer’s.
No mystery add-ons. You’ll know the price for your dog’s size before you book, and it’s the price you pay.
We tell you exactly what your dog got, flag anything we noticed on their skin or coat, and show you how to keep them comfy between visits.
